dictionary_rank_note.why: V >> d and A is full rank, so the LINEAR SPAN of the J-lens vectors is all of R^d; projection onto it is 1.0 for every direction, signal and noise alike, and all principal angles are 0. That is why M3 (k-sparse nonnegative, the paper's own definition) is the primary measure and not this.
